warnings: This tool creates the review at In Progress and stops. It never writes Complete, never writes cm_Review_Stage__c, and never sets the record type. The narrative is staged for a banker to submit through nCino's own Submit for Approval.
Entities added to the borrowing structure after the review is created get no LLC_BI__Review_Account__c snapshot row and become invisible on this review.
Package rollups recalculate based on the running user's record access, so a review opened by an identity with narrower sharing produces narrower rollups.
Do not retry or refresh after this runs. The org is known to create two records on a retried credit action, which is why a resume re-queries first.

inputs.rationale: WS3 wire probe: routine risk rating review with scoring inputs, no override.

warnings: This review is created at In Review. Approved and Declined belong to the org's own RiskRatingReviewDecisioned path and are never written here.
The final risk grade is a formula. This action writes the inputs; the org computes the grade.
A risk rating review launched from a loan can hang with no error when the account violates a validation rule, so this plan verifies by re-query rather than trusting a synchronous success.
Account.LLC_BI__Highest_Risk_Grade__c has a maximum length of two characters. A grade label rather than a number would be refused, so this action never writes it.
result.summary: Opens one risk rating review on ZZ-WS3-PROBE Borrower at status In Review, with the scoring inputs attached. The org computes the final grade from those inputs. No decision is recorded: this action never writes Approved or Declined.

inputs.rationale: WS3 wire probe: new equipment facility on the existing throwaway package.

warnings: The org rewrites the facility name as "Account - Product - Amount". The name you see after creation is the org's, not one this panel chose.

The Loan Detail is created by the org moments after the facility is filed, in its own transaction. This action files the facility and returns; continuing it verifies the Loan Detail and completes the move to Proposal. Nothing is lost in between, and no second confirmation is needed.
The loan officer is assigned by org automation from the account owner, not by this panel.
This action does not suppress org automation. Its two-phase design depends on the async Loan Detail flow.

A borrower row is added to the facility's borrowing structure as part of this action. A facility insert creates none on its own, so without this step the facility would have no borrowing structure at all.
result.summary: Adds the borrower to the facility's borrowing structure at 100 percent ownership. Creates one facility on ZZ-WS3-PROBE Borrower - 8/24/2026 - PP at stage Qualification, status Open, product Equipment, amount 250000. The org names the record and assigns the loan officer. Once nCino has created the Loan Detail, the purpose is written and the facility moves one step to Proposal. Nothing is approved: post-approval stages are unreachable through this panel.
